title: The Fight
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dwight discovers his desk has been moved, leading to a playful search game with Jim. Dwight reveals his karate promotion to purple belt and Sempai. Michael procrastinates on signing important documents and assigns Ryan a seemingly trivial task. Michael and Dwight stage a fight to entertain the office, with Pam expressing concern for her safety. The fight escalates with rules and a referee, while Michael plays pranks on Ryan. Later, Michael promotes Dwight to Assistant Regional Manager on a probationary basis, and Dwight shows gratitude and respect towards Michael.
